name: Ethereal
what_it_means: Ethereal design feels weightless and dreamlike: soft pastel gradients that fade into mist, glowing orbs, grain, delicate thin serifs and lots of air. It evokes calm, spirituality and wellness, using light itself as the main visual element.
signature_moves: Soft pastel gradients that dissolve to white
Glowing orbs, halos and light leaks
Thin, airy serif or light sans type
best_for: Wellness, meditation, skincare, spiritual & beauty brands
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a landing page for [WELLNESS / MEDITATION APP] in an Ethereal style. Background: a soft misty gradient of lavender (#D9C8FF), blush (#FFD9E8) and sky (#CDEBFF) dissolving into near-white (#F7F3FF), with a large glowing white orb and gentle light-leak halos. Add subtle film grain. Headline in a thin, airy serif (Cormorant / Fraunces Light, 72px) in muted plum (#5E5873); body in Inter Light. Translucent pill buttons with soft glow. Elements slowly float (6-10s ease-in-out loops). No hard edges, no strong contrast, plenty of breathing room.
